description: Error codes hx-pack needs in crates/hx-proto/errors.json. Each maps to a JSON-RPC application error (-32000) with the string code in data.code. Tool outcomes (a withheld file, a binary file, a symbol with no match) are NOT errors: they are fields of a successful result.

codes.when: A parameter is out of range or malformed: empty pattern, zero budget, bad line range, bad glob.
The search pattern does not compile as a regular expression.
root is not an existing directory.
A path is absolute, contains .., or resolves through a symlink outside root.
A named file or directory does not exist under root.
lang was given explicitly and no grammar is registered for it.
tree-sitter could not produce a tree (parser setup failure or internal timeout).
The git CLI is missing, exited with an error or printed output that could not be parsed.
The deadline passed before the call finished.
The caller set the cancel flag.
An embedded data file (redact.rules.json, never_pack.json, languages.json) or a query does not load. Fails closed.
An unexpected operating-system error while reading under root.
